name: cache
description: Provisions the caching layer with Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, PID and log directories, service enablement, and cleanup of generated replication settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs and runs a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, a Git checkout, virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd/Uvicorn service.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a multi-site HTTP/HTTPS server, deploys static content, generates development certificates, manages site secrets, and applies host security controls.
